overall: The AG found no quorum deliberation over email on a proposed panhandling order and no violation for considering it without a notice listing, because the Mayor anticipated it fewer than 48 hours ahead; no orders issued, only guidance.

allegations.summary: A complaint alleged the Council deliberated by email when the Mayor's chief secretary emailed all councilors a proposed panhandling order and asked whether they wished to sign on.
allegations.key_passage: we find there was no deliberation because there was no communication between or among a quorum of the Council.

allegations.summary: A complaint alleged the Council discussed and voted on a panhandling order at its June 26, 2012 meeting that was reasonably anticipated 48 hours earlier but was left off the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Council did not violate the Open Meeting Law by considering a topic that was not listed on the meeting notice.
